 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Just In Showbiz 2NE1's CL announces solo comeback 
 By GMA News Published November 17, 2026 3:24pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Courtesy: CL/Instagram Get ready for CL’s comeback!
 The 2NE1 leader and solo artist is set to release her comeback single, “Iconic.”
 The 11-second video teaser showed the word “Iconic," with the release set for November 20 at 5 p.m., Philippine time.
 “Iconic” will be CL’s first single since signing with TheBlackLabel, an associate company of YG Entertainment.
 Other Stories
 2NE1 watches Bigbang concert, thrills fans with group pics
 Sandara Park denies Park Bom's allegations about drug use
 CL debuted as a solo artist in 2013 with the single "The Baddest Female.” Her other songs include “Hello Bitches” and “5 Star.”
 Meanwhile, 2NE1 held their Welcome Back world tour in 2024, serving as the K-pop group’s first reunion concert since their disbandment in 2014. Their tour included a Manila stop in November that year.
 2NE1 is composed of CL, Bom, Dara , and Minzy.
 The K-Pop legends are behind the hits “I Am The Best,” “I Don’t Care,” and “FIRE,” among many others.
 —Nika Roque/CDC, GMA News
